ancestries.desc: The adaptable folk of the valley holds and free towns. Resilient and quick to learn.
ancestries.lore: Hearthborn settled the Vale after the Unweaving and built the Lantern Compact from the ruins.
ancestries.name: Hearthborn

ancestries.desc: Tall, long-lived people of the Thornwood, touched by old Lattice-light.
ancestries.lore: The Vaelin remember the Weavers and do not forgive them.
ancestries.name: Vaelin

ancestries.desc: Stout, stone-blooded folk from beneath Frostspire. Hardy and stubborn.
ancestries.lore: Durrak holds sealed their gates during the Unweaving; many never reopened.
ancestries.name: Durrak

ancestries.desc: Ember-marked descendants of those caught in the Cinder Fall. Faint light burns in their veins.
ancestries.lore: Feared in the Vale, honored in the Wastes.
ancestries.name: Ashkin

ancestries.desc: Beast-blooded clans of the coast and marsh, keen of sense and swift of foot.
ancestries.lore: The Wildborn keep the old tide-calendars and still read storms in the gulls.
ancestries.name: Wildborn

bases.name: Champion's Tabard of the Shattered Hall

bases.desc: A candle-snuffer on a long staff, its brass cone still warm inside. From the Hollow Wick in the Old Chandlery.
bases.name: Snuffer's Crook

classes.desc: Raised in the burnt holds of the Cinderreach, Ravagers trust in heavy steel and thicker skin. Strength builds; life, armor and raw physical damage.
classes.name: Ravager

classes.desc: Sworn protectors of the Lantern Compact. Wardens blend armor and Ward, sacred flame and steady shields, and anchor any group.
classes.name: Warden

classes.desc: Scholars of the shattered Lattice who pull fire, frost and storm from its broken threads. Intelligence builds; spells, Ward and mana.
classes.name: Arcanist

classes.desc: Whisper-trained agents of the Thornwood courts. Shades poison, curse and summon, wearing enemies down instead of meeting them head-on.
classes.name: Shade

classes.desc: Trackers of the Saltreach marshes. Stalkers master bows, traps and evasion, striking from range before the fight reaches them.
classes.name: Stalker

classes.desc: Pit fighters and sellswords of Gullhaven. Skirmishers dual-wield, block and strike fast, trading blows they mean to win.
classes.name: Skirmisher

skills.desc: Sweep your weapon in a wide arc, striking every enemy in front of you.
skills.name: Cleaving Strike

skills.desc: A blessed strike that converts part of its force to holy fire and mends you for each enemy hit.
skills.name: Radiant Strike

skills.desc: Two rapid slashes. Wielding two weapons makes each slash faster.
skills.name: Twin Slash

skills.desc: Smash the earth, sending a shockwave forward that stuns weakened foes.
skills.name: Ground Slam

skills.desc: Spin in place, striking all enemies around you.
skills.name: Whirling Blades

skills.desc: Leap to the target location, crushing enemies where you land.
skills.name: Leap Slam

skills.desc: Ram foes with your shield, stunning them. Requires a shield.
skills.name: Shield Bash

skills.desc: A vicious cut that always causes bleeding.
skills.name: Rending Blow

skills.desc: Tear a fissure through the ground that rips through every enemy in a line.
skills.name: Rift Cleave

skills.desc: Roar to taunt nearby enemies and fortify yourself.
skills.name: Battle Roar

skills.desc: Inspire allies near you to strike harder.
skills.name: Rallying Cry

skills.desc: Charge forward, battering enemies at the end of your rush.
skills.name: Bull Rush

skills.desc: A slow, devastating overhead blow that deals far more damage to wounded foes.
skills.name: Executioner's Swing

skills.desc: Fire a bolt that pierces through several enemies.
skills.name: Piercing Shot

skills.desc: Loose a fan of bolts.
skills.name: Fanfire

skills.desc: Fire into the sky; bolts rain down on the target area.
skills.name: Arrow Squall

skills.desc: A burning bolt that explodes on impact.
skills.name: Kindled Bolt

skills.desc: A frost-tipped bolt that chills and may freeze.
skills.name: Rime Shot

skills.desc: A charged bolt that leaps between enemies.
skills.name: Thunder Quarrel

skills.desc: Throw a trap that bursts into flame and leaves burning ground.
skills.name: Cinder Snare

skills.desc: A brutal trap that crushes and roots the first enemy to trigger it.
skills.name: Iron Jaw

skills.desc: A trap that releases a ring of lightning bolts when triggered.
skills.name: Stormcage

skills.desc: Hurl a bolt of fire that can ignite.
skills.name: Ember Bolt

skills.desc: Release a burst of frost around you, chilling and sometimes freezing.
skills.name: Rime Burst

skills.desc: Lightning arcs from enemy to enemy.
skills.name: Forked Arc

skills.desc: Call down a burning star on the target area after a short delay.
skills.name: Starfall

skills.desc: A piercing lance of ice with a high critical strike chance.
skills.name: Glacial Lance

skills.desc: Summon a storm of hail over an area that chills enemies inside.
skills.name: Hailstorm

skills.desc: A slow orb that zaps nearby enemies as it drifts.
skills.name: Storm Orb

skills.desc: Breathe a wave of fire in a cone.
skills.name: Pyre Wave

skills.desc: Blink a short distance along a thread of the Lattice.
skills.name: Lattice Step

skills.desc: Wrap yourself in a shell of Ward that absorbs damage.
skills.name: Shimmer Shell

skills.desc: Heal yourself and nearby allies, leaving lingering regeneration.
skills.name: Mending Light

skills.desc: Consecrate the ground: allies regenerate life, enemies burn.
skills.name: Sanctified Ground

skills.desc: Strike a target area with a pillar of holy lightning and fire.
skills.name: Judgement

skills.desc: A dart of rot that poisons its target.
skills.name: Blight Dart

skills.desc: Release a cloud of rot that deals chaos damage over time.
skills.name: Miasma

skills.desc: Curse enemies in an area, lowering their elemental resistances.
skills.name: Hex of Unravelling

skills.desc: Curse enemies in an area so they deal less damage and miss more.
skills.name: Hex of Frailty

skills.desc: Mark enemies so they take increased damage from all sources.
skills.name: Mark of Ruin

skills.desc: Raise two Hollow warriors to fight for you for a time.
skills.name: Call the Hollow

skills.desc: Bind a lasting wraith-mage that hurls bolts at your enemies.
skills.name: Bind Wraith

skills.desc: Step through shadow to a location, leaving a burst of rot behind.
skills.name: Shadow Step

skills.desc: Raise a pylon that hurls Ember Bolts at nearby enemies.
skills.name: Flame Pylon

skills.desc: Siphon life from a chain of enemies; you are healed for part of the damage.
skills.name: Essence Siphon

skills.desc: You and nearby allies deal increased attack damage.
skills.name: Banner of Might

skills.desc: You and nearby allies regenerate mana faster.
skills.name: Clarity Hymn

skills.desc: You and nearby allies gain elemental resistances.
skills.name: Resolve

skills.desc: You and nearby allies move faster.
skills.name: Swiftwind

specs.desc: Revels in wounds, his and others'.
specs.name: Bloodreaver

specs.desc: Carries the first light into the dark.
specs.name: Lanternbearer

specs.desc: Rallies all who see the flag.
specs.name: Warbanner

supports.desc: Supported skills fire two additional projectiles.
supports.name: Rune of the Volley

supports.desc: Projectiles and chains jump to two additional targets.
supports.name: Rune of Chaining

supports.desc: Projectiles split in two when they hit.
supports.name: Rune of Forking

supports.desc: Gain physical damage as extra fire.
supports.name: Rune of Kindling

supports.desc: Converts physical damage to chaos and poisons.
supports.name: Rune of Rot

supports.desc: Critical strikes deal far more damage.
supports.name: Rune of Ruin

supports.desc: Supported spells repeat an additional time.
supports.name: Rune of Echoes

supports.desc: Supported melee attacks repeat twice more.
supports.name: Rune of Flurry

supports.desc: Supported skill is thrown as a trap.
supports.name: Rune of the Snare

supports.desc: Supported skill is cast by a totem.
supports.name: Rune of the Pylon

supports.desc: Supported spells are triggered when you critically strike with an attack.
supports.name: Rune of Retaliating Sparks

supports.desc: Supported spells are triggered when you take a heavy blow.
supports.name: Rune of Vengeance

supports.desc: More burning damage and ignite chance.
supports.name: Rune of Spreading Flame

supports.desc: Supported skills poison and deal more damage over time.
supports.name: Rune of Venom

supports.desc: More damage against enemies on low life.
supports.name: Rune of the Executioner

supports.desc: Curses also affect a larger area and last longer.
supports.name: Rune of Hex Bloom

nodes.desc: Skills cost Life instead of Mana.
nodes.name: Bloodbound

nodes.desc: Cold cannot touch you; fire finds you easily.
nodes.name: Frostbitten Heart

nodes.desc: Your spells blaze brighter, but your body is fragile.
nodes.name: Glass Lantern

nodes.desc: Your Ward doubles while your flesh withers.
nodes.name: Hollow Crown

nodes.desc: All your skills resonate one level higher, at a price.
nodes.name: Lattice Resonance

nodes.desc: Nothing moves you, including your own legs.
nodes.name: Stone Heart

nodes.desc: Every lightning strike shocks; you are a lightning rod too.
nodes.name: Stormweaver's Gambit

nodes.desc: More servants, each a little weaker.
nodes.name: Swarmcaller

nodes.desc: You never strike critically, but every blow counts.
nodes.name: Thousand Cuts

nodes.desc: Steel becomes flame; flame remembers you.
nodes.name: Wildfire Pact

flag_text: Ignites spread to nearby enemies when an Ignited enemy dies
uniques.lore: It still beats, faintly, when the cinders fall.
uniques.name: Emberheart

flag_text: Your minions explode on death, dealing 10% of their life as fire damage
uniques.lore: Worn by the last king of Kaldris, who would not stay dead.
uniques.name: The Hollow King's Crown

flag_text: Projectiles return to you after reaching their maximum range
uniques.lore: Every bolt comes home, as every tide does.
uniques.name: Tidecaller

flag_text: Your Cold damage can Ignite
uniques.lore: It never warms, however long you wear it.
uniques.name: Rimeheart

flag_text: Critical strikes heal you for 2% of maximum life
uniques.lore: The axe remembers every wound.
uniques.name: Bloodwake

flag_text: 25% chance on kill to release a nova of 8 fire bolts
uniques.lore: Stitched from the sky the night the Lattice broke.
uniques.name: Starfall Mantle

flag_text: Melee attacks with this weapon hit twice
uniques.lore: Two bites from one mouth.
uniques.name: The Twinned Fang

flag_text: Dodge rolling leaves a trail of burning ground
uniques.lore: They know the road even when you don't.
uniques.name: Wayfinder's Soles

flag_text: Your totems heal allies around them for 2% of life per second
uniques.lore: Swear on it, and it holds you to it.
uniques.name: Oathstone

flag_text: Your first aura reserves no mana
uniques.lore: Sung by the Ashen Choir, it remembers every note.
uniques.name: Choir of Ash

uniques.lore: Brittle, beautiful, and very sharp.
uniques.name: Glassblood Vial

uniques.lore: The first light lit after the Unweaving.
uniques.name: Lantern of Harrowford

flag_text: Your minions explode on death, dealing 10% of their life as fire damage
uniques.lore: It whistles a dirge in the dark.
uniques.name: Gravewind

flag_text: 25% chance on kill to release a nova of 8 fire bolts
uniques.lore: Forged to bring down the Spire itself.
uniques.name: Skybreaker

flag_text: Spells cost Ward instead of Mana while you have Ward
uniques.lore: Look in, and the Lattice looks back.
uniques.name: Mirror of Vael

uniques.lore: Barnacled, and still warm from the deep.
uniques.name: Brinewarden's Carapace

flag_text: Your Cold damage can Ignite
uniques.lore: Hold it to your ear and you can hear her singing.
uniques.name: Siren's Lament

flag_text: Enemies you kill explode in a nova
uniques.lore: The pages are wet. They never dry.
uniques.name: Hymnal of the Deep

flag_text: Projectiles return to you
uniques.lore: The light at its tip has never gone out.
uniques.name: Morrowmaw's Lure

flag_text: Critical strikes heal you
uniques.lore: Cut from Morrowmaw's jaw. It remembers biting.
uniques.name: Abyssal Fang

flag_text: Ignites spread to nearby enemies when an Ignited enemy dies
uniques.lore: The last verse is scorched out. Read the rest aloud and the candles lean toward you.
uniques.name: Vesh's Last Psalm

uniques.lore: A third of a crown, still sharp where he broke it.
uniques.name: Shard of the Sundered Crown

flag_text: Melee attacks with this weapon hit twice
uniques.lore: The blade the king drew on his own heirs. It has not forgotten the taste.
uniques.name: Kingsbane

flag_text: 25% chance on kill to release a nova of 8 fire bolts
uniques.lore: It is warm in the hand and warmer against the skin. Sometimes, at night, it is the only light in the room.
uniques.name: Ilgrim's Spark

uniques.lore: Soot from the Last Lantern's glass, pressed into the stone of a ring. Nothing that walks in the dark can quite see you.
uniques.name: Lampblack

uniques.lore: Silk from the Pale Moth's own cocoon, woven by the last of the Weavers into a robe the colour of the Heartroot's light. It mends itself, thread by thread, while you sleep.
uniques.name: Heartsilk

uniques.lore: A band of charred loom-wood set with a cinder that will not go out. Whatever it burns stays burnt.
uniques.name: Loomfire

uniques.lore: A plank of the Merrow's Due, grown over with barnacles until it turned a cutlass. The tide still pulls at it.
uniques.name: Wreck-Bearer's Hull

uniques.lore: The stern lantern of a ship that sank with all hands. It still lights the way home for those who drowned.
uniques.name: Lantern of the Merrow

uniques.lore: Two of the Colossus's knuckle-stones, still warm. Whatever they close on stays closed.
uniques.name: Heart of the Crater

uniques.lore: Forged in the fire under the Cinder Crater the year before Old Kaldris burned. Its edge has never cooled.
uniques.name: Kaldrian Forgefire

uniques.lore: A circlet of antler, still soft with moss. The Thornwood's deer will follow whoever wears it.
uniques.name: The Velvet Crown

uniques.lore: A crossbow of shed antler strung with Vaelin gut. It never misses a deer, and it was never meant for one.
uniques.name: Elderhorn

uniques.lore: A circlet of the Loomwright's own glass, strung through with a thread of the first warp. Wear it and you can hear the Lattice hum, very faintly, like a kettle in another room.
uniques.name: The Warpthread Crown

uniques.lore: A splinter of the Loomwright's shattered glass, bound to a hilt with the thread that held it. It cuts as easily as that thread was cut.
uniques.name: The Last Knot

uniques.lore: A staff of the Light's old lamp-iron, its head wound with a thread of the Tideloom that never stops glowing. Hold it up at night and the sea lights up to meet it.
uniques.name: The Greywatch Wick

uniques.lore: A knot of the Tideloom's thread left on the shingle when the tide took it out, gone hard and clear as glass. It is always cool to the touch, and very still.
uniques.name: Slack Water

uniques.lore: A belt of the Selvage's old plain thread, tied off in the knot Wenna's grandmother taught her. Nothing that is tied into it ever comes loose.
uniques.name: The Selvage Knot

uniques.lore: A ring of glass spun round a single thread that runs out of it and away, too fine to see. Wherever you go, something at the edge of the world knows.
uniques.name: The Loose End

uniques.lore: A ring of mere-silver turned the right way round, the first thing Ilsabet ever saw the right side of. It shows the world as it is, and nothing behind it.
uniques.name: Right Side Out

uniques.lore: Wenna's spare spindle-whorl on a cord of the Underweave's thread, every knot on it tied by Ilsabet. Whatever comes undone round you, something below is tying it off again.
uniques.name: The Back of the Cloth

uniques.lore: A piece of Tebasli, given freely when she walked away: a disc of the Looking Side's silver that shows the world exactly as it is, except for whoever holds it. In it you have no reflection. Nobody does.
uniques.name: Nobody's Reflection

uniques.lore: The one piece of Tebasli that wouldn't go back into the mere, still cold from the pass, on a cord of Wenna's thread. Look into it and someone always looks back.
uniques.name: Back to the Glass

uniques.lore: The boots Aubrel Corrow walked home in, three hundred years out of fashion and woven through with the far side's thread until nobody could say where the leather stops. They always know the way back.
uniques.name: Walked Home

uniques.lore: One of the First Gatewarden's impossible places, folded small into a book and given you to keep for him on this side of the Gate. Its pages are never the same twice, and not one of them is anywhere you have been.
uniques.name: The Far Face

uniques.lore: A ring of the Spire's crystal the size of a bracelet, struck off the crown when it was mended and given you by the King's Spinster for your trouble. It never quite stops turning, and on a still night you can hear it hum.
uniques.name: The Turning Crown

uniques.lore: Gyda Thrum's spinning mitts, knitted for her by the first of her maids and worn through at the thumb. She pressed them on you as she came out of the ice, saying she would never need them again, and they are still colder than the hands that wore them.
uniques.name: The Stilled Hand

uniques.lore: One blade of the Cutter-off's shears, snapped off at the bow on the edge of her folding table and bound into a grip with her string. It will never cut a cloth off a loom again. It cuts most other things.
uniques.name: The Snapped Shears

uniques.lore: Maud Kerf's apron of the Cloth Guild, leather, worn smooth where a hundred years of cloth went over it, with a string at the belt where the shears hung. She gave it you on the Tenter Ground, since the weaver has the shears now and she has nothing left to carry.
uniques.name: The Cutter-off's Apron

uniques.lore: The Cloth Guild's ell, a yardwand of black pear-wood marked off in brass, broken across the Measurer's knee the morning after the winding-sheet burned. Bound back together with a strip of the sheet's last linen, it will never measure anything true again. It strikes very true.
uniques.name: The Broken Yardwand

uniques.lore: Agnes Ellery's veil of black lawn, that she wore at every laying-out for a hundred years, given you on the Lych Field when the sheet was folded and put away. She says she won't need it for a long while. Short by an ell, the weaver said.
uniques.name: The Layer-out's Veil

uniques.lore: The Cloth Guild's Master's needle, a hand and a half of blued steel, that sewed the coronation coats of seven kings. Orrin Wend threaded the last of the Coat's thread through its eye on the fitting dais and gave it to you. It is threaded still, with something that shimmers.
uniques.name: The Master's Needle

uniques.lore: The Cloth Guild's Master's thimble, of old gold worn thin at the crown by a hundred years of pushing a needle through other people's cloth. Orrin Wend took it off his finger when the Coat went into the Lattice for its lining, and gave it to you. He said it never fitted him anyway.
uniques.name: The Tailor's Thimble

uniques.lore: Iron under black glass. The wire it held is still wound twice round it.
uniques.name: Anchor of the Net

flag_text: Ignites you inflict spread to nearby enemies
uniques.lore: The last verse is written in a different hand, very fast.
uniques.name: Varne's Downward Hymn

flag_text: Enemies you kill explode in a nova
uniques.lore: Cut from the same place the key was. It is warm, and it beats.
uniques.name: Heart of the Fall

flag_text: Critical strikes heal you
uniques.lore: Forged from the length the star was held by. It hums when you swing it.
uniques.name: The Last of the Wire

uniques.lore: Two of its glass wires, and the doorway between them a pick of weft went through every day for longer than anyone has counted.
uniques.name: A Dent of the Reed

flag_text: Projectiles return to you
uniques.lore: Worn smooth by two pairs of hands. Whatever you throw with it comes back to you.
uniques.name: The Quills' Shuttle

flag_text: Your first aura reserves no mana
uniques.lore: Half beaten in. Wenna will not let anyone finish it.
uniques.name: The Last Row

flag_text: Melee attacks with this weapon hit twice
uniques.lore: Mother Halse's own shears, never closed on the last thread. A finished thing is a dead thing.
uniques.name: The Unfinished

uniques.lore: Shed in a single piece the year it woke too big for it, and still cold to the touch. Snow will not settle on it.
uniques.name: Rimeback's Pelt

uniques.lore: Cut from the ice along the bear's back and set on a haft of Fell-pine. Wherever it falls, the snow follows.
uniques.name: The Long Snow
